text:
emily: dropped a compact-latency mock for review: single-row card with P95, micro-heatmap, sampling chip. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-latency-v4
kevin: looks tight. two issues: P95 drops to low contrast at small widths and the heatmap's chevron overlaps the right gutter in Safari.
anya: accessibility: sampling chip skipped by tab in my test. make it role="switch" with aria-checked and include rate in aria-label (eg "Sampling: on, 7%").
emily: good catch. i'll add role/sr label and ensure focusable hit area (visually small but 32px hit).
jordana: copy nit for sampling tooltip: prefer "Sampling enabled — reporting ~7% of requests. Click to adjust." Also for p95 unavailable show "p95 unavailable — <100 samples" not an em dash-only row.
emarcus: animation nit: collapsing shifts P95 horizontally which is annoying in lists. proposal: lock metric width and crossfade the heatmap so numbers stay put.
kevin: agree. also add last-refresh timestamp in the hover popover so users know data age.
a11y-bot: Automated checklist: P95 contrast >= 4.5:1; sampling switch keyboard operable; visible focus ring; aria-live polite update when sampling rate changes; 32px accessible hit target.
emily: plan: update figma with fixed-width metric, outline chip + dot, role=switch + aria-label, sr-only live update, crossfade heatmap, hover popover with timestamp, and revised tooltip copy. will post screenshots when done. thanks! :thumbsup:
